Description.description: Editable AI prompt definitions used by the Sales Briefing Studio. Each prompt drives one of the AI Builder / Power Automate flows (account briefing, contact log extraction, next best actions, weekly recap blog, weekly recap insight). Admins edit prompt content, model, version and enabled state directly from the AI Configuration page in the app.

The actual prompt body sent to the language model. Supports {placeholder} tokens replaced at runtime by the flow.
Name of the Azure AI Foundry deployment this prompt is invoked against. Different prompts can target different deployments (e.g. a cheap mini model for extraction, a stronger model for briefings).
Short explanation of what this prompt does, shown in the UI.
Whether this prompt is currently active. Disabled prompts are skipped by the flows.
Whether this prompt is currently active. Disabled prompts are skipped by the flows.

JSON array describing the variables the Liquid template expects to receive from the flow's context payload. Used by the AI Configuration editor for autocomplete and validation. Example: [{"name":"record","type":"object","description":"The target Dataverse record"},{"name":"logs","type":"array","description":"Related contact logs"}].

When csp_OutputFormat is 'Json', this is the JSON Schema used to validate the model response. Empty for non-JSON outputs. Will also serve as the structural contract for future citation/grounding features.
Stable machine key identifying the prompt (e.g. 'briefing', 'extract', 'nba', 'weekly-blog', 'weekly-insight'). Used by the flows and code app to bind to a specific prompt.

Optional system-role message sent before the user message. Liquid-rendered with the same context payload as csp_Content. Use for persona, tone and global constraints (e.g. 'You are an assistant specialised in B2B sales briefings').
Sampling temperature for the model. 0.0 = deterministic, 1.0 = creative.
